name: test_reset_app_state_restores_the_add_to_cart_buttons[webkit]
description:
The reset leaves the page contradicting itself.

    The badge and the cart are cleared, but every button a customer can see
    still offers to remove a product that is no longer in their cart. Marked
    strict so a fix upstream is noticed rather than silently absorbed.
descriptionHtml:
The reset leaves the page contradicting itself.

The badge and the cart are cleared, but every button a customer can see
still offers to remove a product that is no longer in their cart. Marked
strict so a fix upstream is noticed rather than silently absorbed.
statusMessage:
XFAIL SD-006: Reset App State clears the cart but leaves the catalogue buttons reading 'Remove' until the page is reloaded

AssertionError: Locator expected to have text 'Add to cart'
Actual value: Remove 
Call log:
  - Expect "to_have_text" with timeout 10000ms
  - waiting for get_by_test_id("inventory-list").get_by_test_id("inventory-item").filter(has=get_by_text("Sauce Labs Backpack", exact=True)).locator("button")
    24 × locator resolved to <button id="remove-sauce-labs-backpack" name="remove-sauce-labs-backpack" data-test="remove-sauce-labs-backpack" class="btn btn_secondary btn_small btn_inventory ">Remove</button>
       - unexpected value "Remove"

Aria snapshot:
- button "Remove"
